classes.reading-edge: Reading-relative spacing and joined corners use the logical edge. A physical side variant keeps its named edge.
classes.anchor-and-translation: Read the anchor and signed translation together. A declared physical side, midpoint or collision movement retains its sign; thumb and reading-arrow signs follow local flow.
classes.physical-coordinate: DOM rectangles, pointer coordinates, scroll offsets and exposed physical CSS coordinates remain in browser coordinate space. Numeric ratios are independent of direction.
classes.orientation-and-motion: Spatial input and existing horizontal motion use effective direction. Vertical axes, typed physical options and neutral fades keep their meaning.
classes.glyph: The imported asset or inline SVG keeps its intrinsic path data. The owning reading affordance mirrors only its built-in glyph. Supplied SVGs retain their transforms.
classes.dynamic-paint: The owning component supplies its computed style, variant or SVG. Evaluate signs and physical coordinates together with its named measurement; preserve caller style and icon overrides.
classes.physical-css: Inspect the CSS declaration on its part. Symmetric and vertical dimensions remain unchanged; a side-specific position uses its physical option and reading indentation follows the local inline edge.
classes.edge-and-axis-vocabulary: The surrounding source expression defines the axis. Check the row decision for owner, geometry and direction; shared renderers must also match their concrete projections.
classes.physical-alignment: Object and background positions select the crop or paint origin. Named physical sides and physical origin coordinates keep their axes. Read logical alignment in its owning layout and check collision clearance against the viewport.

dispositions.component: Use the component decision and its rendered assertions for this contract, generated part or Runtime source.
dispositions.shared-runtime: Use the importing component rows. A narrower owner and named measurement identify a component-specific branch inside a shared helper.
dispositions.emitted-expression: The selected recipe, adapter family or contract expression supplies this output. Its component rows identify the measured projections.
dispositions.printer: Adapter syntax, schema, import or validation mechanics. Review the source context and check each generated target through the public coverage assertion.
dispositions.asset: An authored contract imports this SVG resource. Its component row identifies whether the built-in affordance changes with reading direction.
dispositions.stylesheet: The shared theme stylesheet applies to the generated targets. Each component row supplies its corresponding rendered checks.

accordion.decision: Accordion text starts at the reading edge. Expansion and the down chevron operate on the vertical axis.

alert.decision: Status icons and labels retain their semantic order. Symmetric grid gaps and block padding need no sign change.

alert-dialog.decision: Keep the physical midpoint paired with the negative half-size translation. Header text follows inline start.

aspect-ratio.decision: Width and height describe an intrinsic ratio. The media rectangle retains the same dimensions.

avatar.decision: Group overlap uses the compiled logical sibling margin. Image and fallback share a physical crop and ring.

badge.decision: Symmetric horizontal padding surrounds the label. Preserve the supplied icon and anchor behavior.

breadcrumb.decision: Logical gaps separate the list items. Only the default forward chevron follows reading direction.

button.decision: Padding is symmetric. The caller owns the icon and the native disabled or link behavior.

button-group.decision: Round only the exterior inline corners. Top and bottom joins stay physical for vertical groups.

card.decision: Grid order keeps the title, action and description in the same semantic relationship.

carousel.decision: The horizontal controls follow the owning carousel flow. The centered cross-axis uses a physical half translation. Vertical arrows and caller glyphs retain their orientation.

chart.decision: The tooltip body and the legend follow the direction of the chart root, and the tooltip value sits at the inline end. The plot, the axes and the bars keep their physical layout in every direction, as the shadcn (Recharts) charts do.

checkbox.decision: The control-label gap uses logical margins. Check and mixed glyphs retain shape. An owner direction change applies spacing in one frame.

checkbox-group.decision: Native checkbox values, serialization and label association keep DOM order.
